subject: Alternative styling for selectInput drop down

messages.author: 81e5d628e3086299
messages.subject: Alternative styling for selectInput drop down
parts:
Currently drop down for reactive values is generated something like this:

{within UI.r}
 selectInput("pickup_source", "", selected = "All", choices = c(as.list(unique(daily_src$pck_source)))

HTML out put would be something like this:

          <label class="control-label" for="pickup_source"></label>
            <select id="pickup_source">
              <option value="All" selected="selected">All</option>
              <option value="other">other</option>
              <option value="google">google</option>
              <option value="yahoo">yahoo</option>
              <option value="twitter">twitter</option>
            </select>

... now I would like to use list based drop down (looks better, easier to work from styling perspective). Something like this as HTML (bootstrap styling):

<ul class='nav nav-pills nav-stacked'>
    <li class='dropdown'>
       <a class='dropdown-toggle' data-toggle='dropdown',href='#'>
          Select your source:<span class='caret'></span></a>
           <ul class='dropdown-menu'>
             <li><a href='#graph1'>All</a></li>
             <li><a href='#graph2'>other</a></li>
             <li><a href='#graph3'>google</a></li>
             <li><a href='#graph4'>yahoo</a></li>
             <li><a href='#graph5'>twitter</a></li>
           </ul>
     </li>
</ul>


How could I dynamically feed the drop down list and at the same time use the selected values as reactive values?

Thx,
Jonas
